scope: Actual browser recipe panel with real EditorSession, in-memory ProjectStore, native Rust transactions/history and solid recipe Canvas preview; not installed Electron or full visual-field authoring
behavior: Editing a retained draft does not publish before Apply
Real Apply/Undo/Redo change sampled Canvas pixels red/green
Invalid JSON and actual Rust recipe rejection leave the persisted project unchanged and retain the draft
External recipe updates conflict; Discard loads the current source
Replacing recipe with inline/compiled source keeps old text copyable, blocks Apply, and undo restores recipe preview
limitations: Advanced full-recipe JSON editor, not a complete scene/post visual form
Compiled replacement is a descriptor-only refusal fixture, not compiled HTML rendering or attachment download acceptance
In-memory dedicated project only; no user project, installed Creator/Electron, GPU compositor, final export or whole MV acceptance
